entities.name: PMID:25080153
observations: Canadian survey (128/510 respondents, 25%): over 75% lacked confidence in cannabinoid knowledge; 18% were somewhat confident; 70% had never prescribed or recommended cannabinoids.

entities.name: PMID:27101219
observations: Israeli survey (23/119 respondents, 19.3%): about 75% lacked confidence in cannabinoid knowledge or prescribing herbal cannabis; 78% were not confident writing a prescription.

entities.name: PMID:42368993
observations: Moroccan survey (126/400 respondents, 32%): 59.5% reported confidence in cannabinoid knowledge, although only 7.1% had recommended a therapeutic trial.
